source: ml/train/train.py final model, policy replay on a 15% person holdout of the synthetic data

rule.1: largest threshold with detection_rate >= 0.85 (replay, grid step 0.01)
rule.2: smallest threshold with false_activations_per_hour <= 0.5 (replay, grid step 0.01)
rule.3: smallest threshold with false_activations_per_hour <= 0.25 (replay, grid step 0.01)

note: V1 (misc5) thresholds frozen for the controller tests (deployed v018). Tests use this, not controller/config/thresholds.json, so they keep testing the V1 path whatever model ml/runs.py use deployed.
